notes.cards: Keep COOK as the base word. Add a prefix, a suffix, or both to build and compare related words.
notes.mat: Start with COOK in the blue base-word slot. Mat A adds a prefix. Mat B adds a suffix. Mat C adds both a prefix and a suffix.
notes.clues: Build each word from COOK. Notice what changes when a prefix, suffix, or both are added.
notes.recording: Record each word you build. Word sum = show the parts you joined. Literal meaning = what the parts suggest; definition = what the whole word means.
